nodes.description: Token display name string stored in contract storage.
Token symbol string stored in contract storage.
Number of decimals used for token display.
Total token supply; mutated on burn.
Owner address used as the privileged access-control anchor.
Global freeze flag guarding most external entry points.
Mapping of holder balances, read and written by token transfers.
Nested mapping of owner-spender allowances.
Freeze accounting mapping, declared but never used by any function.
Mapping from user address to an external BTB address string.
SafeMath multiplication with an overflow assertion.
SafeMath division with a zero-divisor assertion.
SafeMath subtraction asserting b <= a, used by transfer, transferFrom and burn.
SafeMath addition asserting no wrap-around, used by transfer and transferFrom.
Constructor: mints the entire supply to the deployer and sets metadata and owner.
External token transfer that moves balances from msg.sender to _to.
External approval granting _spender an allowance over msg.sender funds.
External delegated transfer consuming the msg.sender allowance of _from.
Owner-only burn that reduces the caller balance and totalSupply.
Owner-only function that sets isContractFrozen to true.
Owner-only function that clears isContractFrozen.
Stores a caller-supplied BTB address string in btbAddressMapping.
Owner-only ether withdrawal that forwards funds with owner.transfer.
Payable fallback function that accepts ether and executes no logic.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller address used for identity and ownership checks.
owner.transfer(amount): external value call that can trigger recipient code before state finalization.
Parameter _to of transfer: destination address.
Parameter _value of transfer: amount to move.
Parameter _spender of approve: address receiving the allowance.
Parameter _from of transferFrom: debited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom: amount to move.
Parameter _value of burn: amount of tokens destroyed.
Parameter amount of withdrawEther: wei forwarded to the owner.
Parameter btbAddress of setBTBAddress: external address string written to storage.
Parameter a of safeMul: first multiplicand.
Parameter b of safeMul: second multiplicand.
Local variable c inside safeMul holding the unchecked product a * b.

edges.reason: msg.sender is captured as the initial balance holder and owner in the constructor.
Constructor assigns the initial totalSupply.
Constructor writes the full supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role.
Constructor initializes isContractFrozen to false.
Constructor sets the token name metadata.
Constructor sets the token symbol metadata.
Constructor sets the decimals metadata.
transfer is blocked while isContractFrozen is true.
msg.sender supplies the debited account in transfer.
transfer reads balanceOf to validate and debit the sender.
transfer writes updated balances back into balanceOf.
_to determines the credited account in transfer.
_value determines the amount moved in transfer.
transfer delegates its subtraction to safeSub to avoid underflow.
transfer delegates its addition to safeAdd to avoid overflow.
approve is blocked while the contract is frozen.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
_spender becomes the key of the granted allowance.
approve writes the granted amount into the allowance mapping.
transferFrom is blocked while the contract is frozen.
msg.sender acts as the spending spender in transferFrom.
_from selects the debited account in transferFrom.
_value selects the amount moved in transferFrom.
transferFrom reads balanceOf to check _from solvency.
transferFrom updates both debited and credited balances.
transferFrom reads allowance[_from][msg.sender] for the permission check.
transferFrom decrements the consumed allowance.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance subtraction.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit.
burn is blocked while the contract is frozen.
msg.sender must equal owner for burn to proceed, so caller identity gates the operation.
burn compares msg.sender against the stored owner address.
burn reads and debits the caller balance.
burn writes the reduced caller balance.
burn reads totalSupply before reducing it.
burn reduces the stored totalSupply.
_value sets the amount burned.
burn relies on safeSub for the supply and balance decrements.
freeze requires the contract to be unfrozen.
msg.sender must be the owner before the freeze state change.
freeze validates the caller against owner.
freeze sets isContractFrozen to true.
unfreeze requires the contract to be frozen.
msg.sender must be the owner before unfreezing.
unfreeze validates the caller against owner.
unfreeze clears isContractFrozen.
setBTBAddress is blocked while the contract is frozen.
msg.sender is the mapping key written by setBTBAddress.
btbAddress string is the value stored by setBTBAddress.
setBTBAddress writes into btbAddressMapping.
msg.sender must equal owner before any ether can be withdrawn.
withdrawEther gates execution on the owner address.
amount parameterizes the ether value forwarded.
withdrawEther performs an external value transfer to the owner, the classic reentrancy-relevant step.
The external transfer can hand control to a contract owner, whose fallback payable can re-enter the token.
Parameter a feeds the safeMul product.
Parameter b feeds the safeMul product.
safeMul stores the product a * b in local c for the overflow assertion.
safeMul and safeSub are sibling arithmetic guards in SafeMath.
safeDiv and safeAdd form the arithmetic guard set relied on by the token contract.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a transient argument of transfer and carries no standalone semantics.
_value is consumed only by transfer during the balance update.
_spender is only meaningful as the allowance key inside approve.
_from is a transient debited account argument of transferFrom.
_value is consumed only by transferFrom during the transfer update.
_value exists only to size the burn decrement.
amount flows directly into owner.transfer, so it belongs to that unsafe operation.
btbAddress is written straight into the mapping by setBTBAddress.
a is only used inside the safeMul product computation.
b is only used inside the safeMul product computation.
c is a temporary within safeMul used solely for the overflow assertion.
